messages:
farah.partnerships: CrescentSys uploaded their co-branded bundle for the cloud marketplace tile + one-pager. Quick QA request: logos, neutral BG variant, a short customer highlight, and any marketplace content flags. Can we close this by Tue 4pm PT?

liam.design: Taking a look now. Their primary SVG uses a layered radial gradient that rasterizes weirdly. Requested a clean vector and produced a flat two-color fallback in Figma: https://figma.com/file/crescent/crest-redwood-lockups. Recommend the flat lockup for badges <24px.

nora.marketing: Headline draft: "Redwood + CrescentSys: production inference, simplified." Will post two tighter variants (benefit and conservative). Need a 20-word meta summary for marketplace SEO.

pablo.prod: Case study calls out "35% lower per-token cost" but test included KV cache and specialized batching. Suggest we change to: "up to 35% per-token cost reduction on cache-optimized workloads" and include a short test caption: `Test harness: 4xT4, model=redwood-medium, batch=8, cache=enabled`. Also request a p95 latency callout for the tile.

gina.legal: Legal notes: 1) must get a signed co-brand license from CrescentSys legal before publishing; 2) any customer quote needs written consent; 3) marketplace requires a hedging sentence under results: "Performance results are based on specific tests; results may vary." I'll send the addendum template.

liam.design: Uploaded three export sets (SVG, PNG @2x, mono) to the shared Figma link and attached the export zip to the thread. Also added guidance: "Use mono lockup on dark backgrounds; avoid gradient at sizes <48px."

nora.marketing: Posting two headline options: A) "Cut inference cost with Redwood + CrescentSys" B) "Reliable, low-latency inference for production apps" Also draft 20-word meta: "Redwood and CrescentSys deliver predictable, cost-efficient inference with unified tooling and optimized serving for production LLM applications."

pablo.prod: I'll pull p95 numbers from the infra run and attach a short reproducibility note. For marketplace, we should explicitly label hardware: `HW: 4xT4 (shared), batch=8, cache=enabled` so customers can interpret.

assets-bot: Marketplace checklist: missing signed license, customer consent, accessibility contrast report. See https://internal/docs/marketplace-checklist. Deadline: 48h.

farah.partnerships: Plan: liam confirms exports, gina issues addendum request, pablo provides p95 + caption, nora finalizes copy. Target submit Thu morning if all approved. /remind me Tue 3pm to follow up.

gina.legal: Sent co-brand request to CrescentSys legal. Will update when signed.

liam.design: Small note 1: their diagram labels use `k8s` and mixed case microservice names. I'll standardize labels to full words (Kubernetes) and title case.

pablo.prod: Added short reproducibility snippet to the brief. Attaching sample command we used to run the harness: `./run_infer_bench --model redwood-medium --batch 8 --hw t4 --cache on`

nora.marketing: Once p95 arrives I can finalize the short customer highlight and submit two variants for A/B testing.

farah.partnerships: Thanks all 680. If anything blocks, DM me.
